The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```java
FSDataInputStream i = (FSDataInputStream)super.getInputStream(item);
switch(i.readShort()) {
  case 0x1f8b: { // RFC 1952
    // Must be gzip
    ...
  }
```
Reason:
The `fs -text` command retrieves an input stream without resetting its position, which means if the stream is not at the beginning, the subsequent read operations (like `i.readShort()`) will read from the current position, potentially leading to incorrect data being processed.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```java
i.seek(0);
```
Reason:
The `i.seek(0);` statement resets the input stream's position to the beginning before any read operations are performed. This ensures that the data read from the stream is accurate and consistent, preventing unexpected behavior when processing the input stream.
